source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-15: The Blooming Catastrophe

items.name: Spooky
items.text: The scarecrow does not take a penalty to Intimidation checks when using the Demoralize action against targets with whom it does not share a language.

rules.text: The scarecrow does not take a penalty to Intimidation checks when using the Demoralize action against targets with whom it does not share a language.

items.name: Haunting Assault
items.text: The scarecrow makes two claw Strikes against a single creature, then Demoralizes that creature.

items.name: Sudden Charge
items.text: The scarecrow Strides up to twice its speed. If it ends its movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, it can make a claw Strike against that enemy.

items.name: Woodwalk
items.text: The scarecrow ignores difficult terrain from non-magical foliage.
